items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Well, the Coles. Was Rex, Momus, Comus, Proteus? I can't think of the other ones. But those are the four oldest clubs.

ctx.x: How could a parade pay? Parade, parade, five thousand, man. The big carnival parades, too. Yeah. You mentioned about the five organizations, which were those, Rex and Momus and... All of them, the whole five of them were played.
Well, the Coles. Was Rex, Momus, Comus, Proteus? I can't think of the other ones. But those are the four oldest clubs. Those are the prominent fathers. Yes.
I wondered what the five were, yeah. Anyway, those are the main ones. Rex, Comus, Momus, and Proteus. That's it. So those are the big ones today.
